description: End-to-end autonomous live trading daemon. Wires tick capture, SOTA inference, neural agent learning, soak evaluation, and model promotion into a single self-driving loop. Builds on existing ContinuousScanner + AutonomousTrainer + ExecutionManager infra. Source: user directive (Option C).

userStories.title: Wire tick capture daemon into ContinuousScanner maintenance loop
userStories.description: The TickCaptureDaemon (scripts/run_tick_capture.py) runs standalone. ContinuousScanner has a maintenance loop that runs between scans. Wire the daemon lifecycle (start/stop/health) into ContinuousScanner so tick capture starts when the scanner starts and shuts down gracefully on exit.
acceptanceCriteria: TickCaptureDaemon.start() is called inside ContinuousScanner.run() before the first scan
TickCaptureDaemon.shutdown() is called in ContinuousScanner._graceful_shutdown()
If tick capture fails to start, log warning but DO NOT block the scan loop (fault tolerant)
Config flag 'enable_tick_capture' added to ContinuousConfig (default True)
Tick capture status (running/stopped/error) is exposed in scan cycle log
userStories.notes: Implemented by Dex in autonomous session 2026-06-16. See commits 22a9036 and b3e28a7.

userStories.title: Auto-aggregate captured ticks to candles after buffer flush
userStories.description: Currently TickPersister writes raw ticks to partitioned parquet. Add an optional post-flush hook that immediately aggregates new ticks to S5/M15 candles and appends them to the existing harvest parquet files (trained_data/harvest/{pair}_S5.parquet). This ensures the training pipeline always sees fresh data without waiting for a manual harvest run.
acceptanceCriteria: TickPersister.flush() accepts an optional on_flush callback
Callback invokes aggregate_ticks_to_candles() with the newly flushed ticks
Aggregated candles are appended to trained_data/harvest/{pair}_S5.parquet (or M15)
Duplicate bars are dropped by (timestamp, pair) before append (idempotent)
Callback runs in the same thread (synchronous) to maintain ordering guarantees
If aggregation fails, log error but do not lose the raw tick parquet
userStories.notes: Implemented by Dex in autonomous session 2026-06-16. See commit f78c114.

userStories.title: Add SOTA shadow test alongside incumbent-vs-candidate A/B framework
userStories.description: ModelManager currently A/B tests incumbent vs candidate traditional models. Add a third shadow lane for SOTA inference: on every scan, run legacy ensemble AND SOTA model on identical raw OHLCV, log both predictions to shadow_predictions.jsonl with a new 'sota_direction' field. This enables live comparison without risking capital.
acceptanceCriteria: Shadow test logs include 'sota_direction', 'sota_confidence' fields for every actionable pair
SOTA inference runs only if use_sota_inference=True in config AND model file exists
SOTA failure is graceful: if inference errors, log null and continue (never crash scan)
Shadow predictions JSONL schema extended with sota_* fields; backward compatible with existing ModelManager scoring
Config flag 'enable_sota_shadow' added (default True when use_sota_inference=True)
userStories.notes: Implemented by Dex in autonomous session 2026-06-16. See commits 22a9036 and b3e28a7.

userStories.title: Update NeuralAgentTeam policies from live trade outcomes in trade-close loop
userStories.description: When a trade closes in the learning loop (continuous.py:_run_learning_loop), the system updates pair performance, adaptive scalers, and counterfactual learners. Add a call to NeuralAgentTeam.update_weights_from_outcome() to trigger gradient updates on each agent's policy network using the trade's feature vectors and binary correctness label.
acceptanceCriteria: NeuralAgentTeam.update_weights_from_outcome() is called for every closed trade with agent_verdicts + trade_won
If use_neural_agents=False, the call is skipped (no-op)
Update runs asynchronously (background thread) so it never blocks journal sync
After update, policies are saved to disk (trainer.save_policies())
Update count and average loss are logged per agent for observability
userStories.notes: Implemented by Dex in autonomous session 2026-06-16. See commits 22a9036 and b3e28a7.

userStories.title: Neural agent ramp-up sizing with cold-start protection
userStories.description: Neural agents start with untrained policy networks. Until each agent accumulates at least MIN_LIVE_SAMPLES (default 100) trade outcomes, its policy weights are effectively random. Add a ramp-up mechanism: position sizing for trades approved by neural agents is scaled by min(trade_count / MIN_LIVE_SAMPLES, 1.0). Also block trades where ANY approving agent has fewer than MIN_LIVE_SAMPLES.
acceptanceCriteria: ExecutionManager reads neural agent sample counts from trainer state
Position sizing multiplied by ramp_factor = min(agent_samples / 100, 1.0) for approving agents
If ANY approving agent has < 20 samples, trade is blocked with reason 'neural_agent_cold_start'
Config flag 'neural_agent_min_samples' added (default 100, tunable per regime)
Ramp-up status logged per trade: 'ramp_factor=0.45 (samples=45/100)'
After 100 samples, ramp_factor reaches 1.0 and normal sizing resumes
userStories.notes: Implemented by Dex in autonomous session 2026-06-16. See commits 22a9036 and b3e28a7.

userStories.title: Automated soak orchestration after SOTA finetune completes
userStories.description: After AutonomousTrainer spawns a background SOTA finetune (or a manual training run finishes), automatically trigger the soak pipeline: run SOTA in shadow mode alongside legacy on held-out data, compute error correlation, and emit a recommendation (STACK / REPLACE / DISCARD). The soak runs in a background subprocess so training completion doesn't block the scan loop.
acceptanceCriteria: AutonomousTrainer emits a 'training_complete' signal when SOTA finetune finishes
Signal triggers SoakRunner.run_soak_comparison() in a background Process
Soak uses held-out data (last 10% of harvested candles, or last 500 bars if < 5000 total)
SoakResult is persisted to trained_data/soak_results/{pair}_{timestamp}.json
If soak fails (model missing, data insufficient), log error and skip — do not block trading
Soak status visible in scan cycle log: 'soak_running', 'soak_complete', 'soak_error'
userStories.notes: Implemented by Dex in autonomous session 2026-06-16. See commit 15b0e37.

userStories.title: Wire soak recommendation into model promotion gate
userStories.description: ModelManager._check_model_promotion() currently promotes based on shadow test accuracy. Extend the gate to require: (1) soak recommendation is REPLACE or STACK, AND (2) SOTA shadow accuracy > legacy shadow accuracy over last N scans. Only promote if ALL gating conditions pass.
acceptanceCriteria: ModelManager reads latest SoakResult for each pair before promotion decision
Promotion blocked if soak recommendation == DISCARD or UNDECIDED
Promotion blocked if sota_shadow_accuracy <= legacy_shadow_accuracy over last 200 actionable scans
If soak recommends STACK but not REPLACE, SOTA is added as a 5th ensemble component (augment mode) instead of full replacement
Promotion decision logged with full gating context: soak_rec, sota_acc, legacy_acc, improvement
Rollback preserves previous model weights if promotion degrades performance
userStories.notes: Implemented by Dex in autonomous session 2026-06-16. See commit 15b0e37.

userStories.title: Autonomous SOTA training pipeline triggered from accumulated tick candles
userStories.description: When tick-aggregated candles reach a threshold (e.g., 5000 new bars since last training), AutonomousTrainer automatically triggers SOTA pre-training (self-supervised) followed by finetuning (supervised) using the freshest data. Training lineage is tracked so each model knows its data provenance.
acceptanceCriteria: AutonomousTrainer checks 'bars_since_last_train' for each pair every cycle
Threshold 'sota_retrain_bars' added to config (default 5000)
When threshold crossed: spawn SOTATrainer.pretrain() then finetune() as chained subprocesses
Training uses tick-aggregated S5 candles (higher fidelity than M15)
Model artifact saved with lineage: source_data_range, n_bars, training_duration, val_loss
Old model kept as backup; only 2 most recent backups retained to manage disk
Training completion triggers soak (US-006) automatically
userStories.notes: Implemented by Dex in autonomous session 2026-06-16.

userStories.title: Auto-promote SOTA to live inference when all gates pass
userStories.description: When ModelManager determines promotion criteria are met (shadow tests + soak), automatically flip use_sota_inference=True in runtime config AND persist to config file. If augment mode (STACK), add SOTA as a 5th ensemble component without disabling legacy. Emit a TUI-visible promotion announcement.
acceptanceCriteria: On promotion: config.use_sota_inference set to True in memory
Config change persisted to config/config_improved_H1.yaml (or active config file)
Scanner engine hot-reloads config without restart (uses existing config watcher)
If augment mode: SOTAInference added as 5th component to ModularEnsembleInference
Promotion announcement printed to console/TUI with green badge
Promotion event logged to trained_data/model_promotions.jsonl with timestamp, reason, improvement metrics
userStories.notes: Implemented by Dex in autonomous session 2026-06-16. See commit 15b0e37.

userStories.title: Add Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) to neural agent policies
userStories.description: Neural agents currently use online gradient descent with a replay buffer. Without regularization, they forget older market regimes when new data arrives. Add optional EWC: after each batch of online updates, penalize weight changes proportional to their Fisher information from previous training phases. Prevents catastrophic forgetting.
acceptanceCriteria: NeuralAgentConfig adds 'use_ewc' flag (default False, conservative)
NeuralAgentTrainer computes Fisher Information matrix after each training phase
Online updates apply EWC penalty: loss += lambda_ewc * sum(F_i * (theta_i - theta_old_i)^2)
Fisher info stored per policy in trained_data/models/neural/{agent_name}_fisher.npz
EWC lambda is tunable per agent (default 1e-4)
Unit test: train on regime A, switch to regime B, verify agent still performs on A (within 10% of original accuracy)
userStories.notes: Implemented by Dex in autonomous session 2026-06-16.

userStories.title: Health monitoring and alerting for tick capture daemon
userStories.description: The tick capture daemon runs in a background thread and can silently stall (connection drop, parsing error, disk full). Add health checks: monitor ticks received per minute, heartbeat from OANDA stream, and disk space. Alert via console/TUI if throughput drops below threshold.
acceptanceCriteria: TickCaptureDaemon exposes health metrics: ticks/min, last_tick_time, stream_status, disk_usage_pct
Health checked every scan cycle in ContinuousScanner maintenance loop
Alert triggered if ticks/min < 1 for 2 consecutive minutes (below expected ~5-10/min)
Alert message visible in TUI diagnostics screen and console output
Auto-restart: if stream_status == 'dead', daemon attempts reconnect automatically (3 retries)
Health metrics persisted to trained_data/tick_health.jsonl for post-mortem analysis
userStories.notes: Implemented by Dex in autonomous session 2026-06-16. See commit fda9c4c.

userStories.title: SOTA model artifact versioning and rollback
userStories.description: SOTA models are currently saved as flat .keras files with no versioning. When auto-promotion occurs, there is no reliable way to roll back if the promoted model degrades. Implement versioned artifacts: timestamped directories with model + config + lineage + validation metrics.
acceptanceCriteria: SOTA model artifacts saved to trained_data/models/sota_versions/{timestamp}/ with files: model.keras, config.json, lineage.json, metrics.json
Symlink 'trained_data/models/sota_finetuned/latest' always points to newest version
ModelManager promotion atomically swaps symlink after validation passes
Rollback command available: scripts/rollback_sota.py --to-version {timestamp}
Retention policy: keep last 10 versions, auto-delete older (configurable)
Version manifest (trained_data/models/sota_versions/manifest.json) tracks all versions with promotion history
userStories.notes: Implemented by Dex in autonomous session 2026-06-16.

userStories.title: Dry-run mode for full autonomous loop (zero live trades)
userStories.description: Before deploying the fully autonomous loop with live capital, operators need a dry-run mode where all components execute (tick capture, training, soak, shadow tests, neural updates) but NO trades are sent to the broker. All execution decisions are logged as 'would_execute' entries.
acceptanceCriteria: Config flag 'dry_run' added to ContinuousConfig (default False)
When dry_run=True: scanner evaluates normally, shadow tests run, trades are scored but NOT sent to broker
ExecutionManager checks dry_run before place_order() and logs 'WOULD_EXECUTE' instead
Neural agents still update from 'simulated' outcomes (dry-run outcomes are treated as real for learning)
Soak pipeline runs normally (no broker interaction anyway)
Dry-run status prominently displayed in TUI header and console banner
Config can flip dry_run→False at runtime (hot reload) to go live
userStories.notes: Implemented by Dex in autonomous session 2026-06-16. See commit fda9c4c.
